1.mascotDialogue: Build the heap once, then simply keep pulling the maximum off the top. Each pull locks one more element into its correct final spot.

2.mascotDialogue: Two loops: build the heap once, lines 2 and 3, then repeatedly swap-and-shrink, lines 5 through 7. The 'end' boundary shrinking each time is what carves out the sorted region at the back.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar get walked to the top, then swapped to the far right — that's one value locked into its sorted home.

4.mascotDialogue: This is the step easiest to forget, because the array still appears to change each loop. It simply never converges into sorted order without it, however busy it looks.
